pr.title: Extract clipboard data creation without changing Copy chat ID
pr.body:
Done when
Tapping Copy chat ID then pasting puts the host ID into the composer; chats without an ID paste their tmux name.

diff:
diff --git a/app/src/main/java/dev/multiprompt/companion/ui/MultipromptApp.kt b/app/src/main/java/dev/multiprompt/companion/ui/MultipromptApp.kt
--- a/app/src/main/java/dev/multiprompt/companion/ui/MultipromptApp.kt
+++ b/app/src/main/java/dev/multiprompt/companion/ui/MultipromptApp.kt
@@ -4129,7 +4129,8 @@
                                         onClick = {
                                             menuExpanded = false
                                             val clipboard = context.getSystemService(Context.CLIPBOARD_SERVICE) as ClipboardManager
-                                            clipboard.setPrimaryClip(ClipData.newPlainText("$displayName chat ID", chatId))
+                                            val clip = ClipData.newPlainText("$displayName chat ID", chatId)
+                                            clipboard.setPrimaryClip(clip)
                                             android.widget.Toast.makeText(context, dev.multiprompt.companion.model.ChatId.COPIED, android.widget.Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                                         },
                                     )

parent.driver-transcript.txt:
+ tap_text 'Session actions'
+ tap_text 'Copy chat ID'
+ adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_PASTE
+ tap_text Inbox
+ tap_text verify-name
+ tap_text 'Copy chat ID'
+ adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_PASTE
Driver exit 0
